newEntriesNeeded.title: undefined() — Check if a global variable is uninitialized
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Use undefined() to safely check whether a global variable (prefixed with !!) has been assigned before use. Prevents BADREF errors on first access.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Call undefined(!!globalVar) before accessing the variable. Returns BOOLEAN.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: lazy global initialization
if(undefined(!!ramCommonLogger)) then
  !!ramCommonLogger = object RAMCOMMONLOGGER()
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: !!ramCommonLogger.addLogDetails(...) -- may throw BADREF on first call
pitfalls: undefined() only works on global variables (!! prefix), not local variables

newEntriesNeeded.title: !!error.text — Global error message in handle/elsehandle
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Inside a handle/elsehandle block, !!error.text contains the human-readable error message from the last exception.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Access !!error.text only inside handle or elsehandle blocks. Contains string description of the error.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: error message capture
handle any
  !this.addErrorToList(!element.name, !attribute, 'ER13 - ' + !!error.text + !additionalMessage)
elsehandle None
  !attributeType = !currentValue.objecttype()
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: !msg = !!error.text -- outside handle block returns empty or undefined
pitfalls: PML is case-insensitive but !!Error.text and !!error.text are the same

newEntriesNeeded.title: MEASURE and FORMAT objects — Unit conversion and formatting
newEntriesNeeded.principle: MEASURE wraps a unit string and provides dbunit() for database unit conversion. FORMAT controls numeric string output including units and trailing zeros.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: unit conversion with formatting
!measure = object MEASURE(!unit)
!dbUnit = !measure.dbunit()
!format = object FORMAT()
!format.units = !dbUnit.string()
!format.TRAILZEROS = false
!realValue = object REAL(!tempValue)
!result = !realValue.string(!format)
pitfalls: MEASURE requires a valid unit string

newEntriesNeeded.title: DATETIME and DATEFORMAT objects — Timestamp generation
newEntriesNeeded.principle: DATETIME provides current date/time components. DATEFORMAT formats them into strings with configurable patterns.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: timestamp-based filename
!time = object DATETIME()
!dateFormat = object DATEFORMAT('Y_M_D')
!dateStr = !dateFormat.string(!time)
!fileName = !dateFormat.string(!time) + '_' + !time.hour().string() + !time.minute().string() + !time.second().string()
pitfalls: DATEFORMAT pattern uses Y_M_D not YYYY-MM-DD

newEntriesNeeded.title: skip if(condition) — Conditional early loop iteration
newEntriesNeeded.principle: skip if(condition) skips the current iteration when the condition is true. It is a compound form of the skip statement.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: skip if(!condition) — equivalent to 'if (!condition) then skip endif'
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: skip pseudo attributes and unmapped columns
if(!isNameUpdate.not()) then
  skip if(!isPseudo)
endif
skip if(!isMasterUnmapped)
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: if(!isPseudo) then skip endif -- more verbose than skip if(!isPseudo)
pitfalls: skip if() only works inside DO/ENDDO loops

newEntriesNeeded.title: SHOW — Display a form by global reference
newEntriesNeeded.principle: SHOW statement displays a form identified by a global variable reference. Used to present user-facing dialogs from PML code.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: SHOW !!formGlobalVar — displays the form referenced by the global variable
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: show reclassification form
SHOW !!ramimportExcelReclassificationForm
!!ramimportExcelReclassificationForm.loadData(!this)
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: show !localForm -- SHOW requires global variable reference
pitfalls: SHOW requires a global (!!) form reference, not a local variable

newEntriesNeeded.title: displayProgress() — Show import progress bar
newEntriesNeeded.principle: displayProgress(current, total) displays a progress indicator in the AVEVA UI. Used for long-running import loops.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Call with (current, total) parameters. PML is case-insensitive so !!displayProgress works.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
!!displayProgress(1, 100)
do !i from 1 to !total
  if(!i.gt(!onePercent)) then
    !!displayProgress(!i, !total)
  endif
enddo
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB obj_06: progress tracking in import loop
!!displayProgress(1, 100)
do !index indices !masterList
  if(!index.gt(!onePercentValue)) then
    !!displayProgress(!index, !masterList.size())
  endif
enddo
pitfalls: Requires two parameters: current count and total
Call sparingly to avoid UI flicker
